# Pattern catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_patterns_md.py from scripts/patterns.json. Edit the JSON, then re-run. -->

120 patterns. Each hit adds its **weight** to the text's weighted total; single words weigh 0.3-1.5, stock phrases about 2, and structural frames 2-3, because one word proves little and a template proves more. Matching is per line and case-insensitive; when two patterns overlap on a line only the heavier one counts. A hit is a *style signal*, never evidence of who wrote the text.

False-positive guards are built into the regexes: `robust` only matches generic praise ("robust solution"), not statistics ("robust standard errors"); `leverage` skips "financial/operating leverage"; `landscape` only matches figurative uses ("the digital landscape"); `foster` skips "foster care"; `elevate` skips "elevated levels".

## Clichéd vocabulary

| id | weight | example | why it reads as AI | try instead |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `delve` | 1.5 | Let's delve into the details. | Rare in everyday prose but heavily over-used by chat models. | look at, dig into, cover |
| `tapestry` | 1.5 | The city is a rich tapestry of cultures. | Decorative metaphor stretched over anything complicated. | mix, range; or name the actual parts |
| `testament-to` | 1.5 | The bridge stands as a testament to human ingenuity. | Ceremonial phrasing that praises instead of showing. | shows, proves; or state the evidence |
| `landscape-figurative` | 1 | Startups must adapt to the evolving landscape. | Figurative 'landscape' stands in for a field the writer never describes. | market, field; or say what actually changed |
| `navigate-complexities` | 1.5 | We help teams navigate the complexities of compliance. | Vague motion metaphor for 'deal with'. | handle, deal with, work through |
| `seamless` | 1 | Enjoy a seamless onboarding experience. | Marketing adjective; rarely true and never specific. | say what step it removes |
| `leverage` | 0.5 | We leverage AI to improve outcomes. | Corporate verb for 'use'. Fine as a finance term, which this pattern tries to skip. | use |
| `unlock-potential` | 2 | This course will unlock your full potential. | Promise without content: what exactly gets better? | state the concrete result |
| `game-changer` | 1.5 | Dark mode is a game-changer. | Hype word that replaces evidence. | say what changed and by how much |
| `elevate` | 1 | These tips will elevate your writing. | Aspirational filler verb. | improve, raise; or say how |
| `robust-generic` | 1 | We built a robust framework for growth. | 'Robust' as generic praise. Correct technical uses (robust statistics, robust estimator) are not matched. | reliable, well-tested; or give the failure case it handles |
| `cutting-edge` | 1 | Our cutting-edge platform does it all. | Stock praise that dates instantly. | new; name the technique |
| `harness-power` | 2 | Harness the power of data. | Stock phrase for 'use'. | use |
| `realm` | 1.5 | In the realm of software, change is constant. | Inflated way to say 'in'. | in |
| `foster` | 1 | Retros foster a culture of trust. | Abstract nurturing verb attached to an abstract noun. | build, encourage; or describe the practice |
| `paramount` | 1 | Security is paramount. | Formal intensifier ('safety is paramount'). | most important; or just say it first |
| `vibrant` | 0.5 | A vibrant community of makers. | Default positive adjective for places, communities and colors. | a specific detail |
| `resonate` | 1 | This message will resonate with readers. | Vague claim about emotional impact. | say who it convinced and why |
| `embark` | 1 | Before you embark on this project, plan ahead. | Ceremonial verb for 'start'. | start, begin |
| `journey-figurative` | 1.5 | Wherever you are in your learning journey, start small. | Turns any process into a 'journey'. | process, path; or describe the steps |
| `pivotal` | 1 | It was a pivotal moment for the company. | Inflated importance word. | key, important; or explain the consequence |
| `unparalleled` | 0.5 | It offers unparalleled flexibility. | Superlative claim without comparison. | compare to something specific |
| `underscore` | 1 | This underscores the importance of testing. | Formal verb chat models use for 'shows'. | shows |
| `treasure-trove` | 1.5 | The archive is a treasure trove of letters. | Stock metaphor. | collection; say what's in it |
| `beacon-of` | 1.5 | The library is a beacon of hope. | Ceremonial metaphor. | say what it actually does |
| `enduring-legacy` | 1 | Her work leaves an enduring legacy. | Eulogy phrasing. | say what remains and where |
| `delicate-interplay` | 1 | It depends on a delicate interplay of heat and pressure. | Decorative metaphor for 'interaction'. | say how A affects B |
| `ever-evolving` | 1.5 | In this ever-evolving field, keep learning. | Stock intensifier. | changing; say what changes |
| `forefront` | 1 | We are at the forefront of innovation. | Stock positioning phrase. | leading; give the evidence |
| `invaluable` | 0.5 | Mentors are invaluable. | Praise word that skips the reason. | say why it is worth it |
| `cornerstone` | 0.5 | Trust is the cornerstone of any team. | Architectural metaphor for 'important part'. | core, main; or explain the dependency |
| `breathtaking` | 0.5 | The view is breathtaking. | Generic wonder adjectives. | a concrete detail the reader can picture |

## Filler and hedging

| id | weight | example | why it reads as AI | try instead |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `important-to-note` | 2 | It's important to note that results may vary. | Throat-clearing before the actual point. | delete it and state the point |
| `plays-a-role` | 2 | Sleep plays a crucial role in memory. | Vague importance claim. | say what it does |
| `hedge-stack` | 2 | This may potentially reduce costs. | Stacked hedges. | pick one: may, or nothing |
| `when-it-comes-to` | 1.5 | When it comes to pricing, less is more. | Wordy topic shift. | for, with, in |
| `wide-range` | 1 | We offer a wide range of services. | Padding quantifier. | list two or three, or give the number |
| `serves-as` | 2 | The story serves as a powerful reminder of what matters. | Inflated copula for 'is'. | is; or what it does |
| `stands-as` | 1.5 | The tower stands as a symbol of the city. | Ceremonial copula. | is |
| `at-its-core` | 1 | At its core, the idea is simple. | Fake depth marker before a plain definition. | delete it |
| `transition-adverb` | 1 | It is fast. Additionally, it is cheap. | Sentence-initial connective used as rhythm filler. | and, also; or no connective |
| `power-of` | 1 | Never underestimate the power of habit. | Abstract hype noun phrase. | say what it does |
| `make-a-difference` | 1.5 | Small habits make a big difference. | Vague impact claim. | say what changes |
| `whether-youre` | 2 | Whether you're a beginner, a hobbyist, or a pro, this guide is for you. | Audience-widening clause that targets no one. | pick the reader you are writing for |
| `stock-idioms` | 1.25 | Hybrid work offers the best of both worlds. | Stock idioms. | say who it fits / name the two benefits |

## Contrast frames ("not just X, it's Y")

| id | weight | example | why it reads as AI | try instead |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `not-just-x-its-y` | 3 | This isn't just a tool, it's a movement. | The 'not just X, it's Y' frame: sets up a strawman to sound profound. | state Y directly |
| `not-about-x-its-about-y` | 3 | It's not about speed. It's about trust. | 'It's not about X, it's about Y' reframe. | state Y directly |
| `more-than-just` | 2 | Libraries are more than just books. | Inflation frame. | say what else it is |
| `not-only-but-also` | 1 | It is not only faster but also cheaper. | Formal correlative; normal English, but over-used in generated text. | two plain sentences |
| `rhetorical-reveal` | 3 | The result? A 40% faster build. | Q-and-A reveal ('The result? ...'). | just state it |
| `heres-the-thing` | 2 | But here's the thing: nobody reads the docs. | Faux-candid pivot. | delete it and say the thing |
| `no-x-no-y-just-z` | 3 | No fluff. No filler. Just results. | Staccato slogan triad. | one plain sentence |
| `faux-candid` | 1.5 | And honestly? It changed everything. | Faux-candid beat typical of generated 'casual' text. | delete it |

## Formatting and structure

| id | weight | example | why it reads as AI | try instead |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `bold-lead-in-bullet` | 2 | - **Speed:** Builds finish in seconds. | Every bullet starts with a bold label and a colon: the house style of chat answers. | plain bullets, or prose |
| `colon-headed-bullet` | 1 | - Speed: Builds finish in seconds. | 'Label: explanation' bullets; normal in references, slop when every list is built this way. | vary the list or use prose |
| `bold-as-heading` | 1.5 | **Why It Matters** | Bold line used as a heading in a short answer. | a sentence that leads into the section |
| `bold-everywhere` | 2 | Use **clear** names, **short** functions and **small** files. | Three or more bold spans on one line: emphasis everywhere means emphasis nowhere. | bold at most one thing |
| `emoji-line-start` | 2.5 | 🚀 Launching today! | Emoji as bullets or heading decorations. | plain bullets and headings |
| `emoji-inline` | 1 | We shipped it 🎉 | Decorative emoji in prose. | delete it |
| `hashtag-block` | 3 | Thanks all! #AI #Leadership #Growth | Block of hashtags. | one or none |
| `arrow-bullet` | 2 | → Ship small changes | Arrow bullets (social-post style). | plain bullets or prose |
| `one-word-line` | 2 | Period. | One-word dramatic paragraph. | fold it into a sentence |
